defects: Fixes the set s to Set.univ instead of keeping s as a general free variable, dropping the 'part of a set' generality (and the a ∈ s, b ∈ s hypotheses) that is central to the informal statement

Adds a hypothesis a ≤ b not present in the gold statement; gold holds unconditionally for all a, b since s ∩ Icc a b and ENNReal.ofReal(b-a) both degenerate correctly when b < a
